visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian woman with long black hair, wearing a brown plaid shirt, holds a red Haribo gummy bag in front of her. She is in an indoor room with wooden walls and framed pictures in the background. Her facial expressions are animated, shifting between smiles and wide eyes as she gestures with her left hand while holding the candy. (2) A video overlay titled '示範影片' (Demonstration Video) appears, showing another woman with blonde hair opening a gummy bag. The main character watches and continues her own demonstration. (3) The main character focuses on the red plastic packaging, using her fingers to carefully tear a specific part of the top corner. The lighting is bright and even across the indoor scene. (4) She continues the physical process of tearing a thin strip from the back seam of the gummy bag. Graphical question mark overlays and variety-show style text appear as she expresses confusion through squinted eyes and a tight-lipped expression. (5) She manages to tear a long strip of plastic and begins rolling the top of the bag down. She then attempts to use the torn strip to tie the bag shut, wrapping it around the folded plastic. (6) She holds up the resulting tied bag, which looks messy. Thumbs-down emoji graphics and red arrows appear on screen to highlight her attempt. She finishes by looking directly at the camera with a resigned smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful female voice introduces the 'secret' of gummy bears with a high-energy intonation. Bouncy, rhythmic piano-led background music starts at approximately 124 BPM. (2) As she discusses seeing a video online, the BGM continues with a light, toy-like synth texture. (3) The audio is punctuated by the sharp, crunchy sound of plastic tearing as she attempts the hack. (4) Frequent 'pop' and 'cartoon ding' sound effects occur every few seconds, matching the appearance of question mark graphics. The speaker's voice takes on a more hesitant, analytical tone. (5) A loud, continuous 'zip' sound of plastic tearing is heard as she pulls a strip from the bag. The speaker sounds surprised and excited. (6) The vocal delivery becomes humorous as she admits the result isn't perfect. A final comedic bubble-pop SFX marks the end of the explanation over the fading music.
